name: UISP
description: UISP is Ubiquiti's management platform for ISP networks. It manages airMAX, airFiber and other UISP devices, and includes a CRM and billing module.
notes: On first access UISP asks you to accept the terms and create the main account (username, password and email). There are no default credentials.
Device firmware is managed from Settings > Updates. UISP itself shows a notification when a new version is available and can be updated from the web interface.
Back up from Settings > Backup before updating.
The CRM module may take a few minutes to become available after installation.
